SELECT
    ch.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel ch
    ON f.channel_key = ch.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY ch.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT d.display_name AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction d
  ON f.jurisdiction_key = d.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON f.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.calendar_date) = 2025
GROUP BY d.display_name
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT
    dc.display_name AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dc.complaint_category_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    AVG(f.average_rate) AS avg_daily_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.iso_alpha_code
ORDER BY c.iso_alpha_code;

SELECT
    m.market_id,
    m.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(f.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market m
  ON f.market_key = m.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY m.market_id, m.display_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.dim_account
WHERE opened_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND opened_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY account_type_code
ORDER BY account_type_code;

SELECT
    b.city_name AS branch_city,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY atm_transactions DESC;

SELECT AVG(f.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(mid_rate) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.currency_code = 'USD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12;

SELECT d.month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
 WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
 GROUP BY d.month_number
 ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY customer_segment_code
ORDER BY customer_segment_code;

WITH tx_2025 AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.customer_key
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
),
all_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_key
  FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_no_tx_2025
FROM all_customers ac
LEFT JOIN tx_2025 t ON ac.customer_key = t.customer_key
WHERE t.customer_key IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    dc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dc.complaint_category_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fc.is_escalated = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    ch.display_name AS channel_name,
    SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel ch
    ON fat.channel_key = ch.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY ch.display_name
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS aml_alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON f.business_date_key = dt.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction d
  ON f.jurisdiction_key = d.jurisdiction_key
WHERE f.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.calendar_date) = 2025
GROUP BY d.display_name
ORDER BY aml_alert_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.loan_id) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2025-08-31'
  AND f.days_past_due > 90;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS mobile_app_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
WHERE c.display_name = 'Mobile App'
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    lp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fod.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement fod
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product lp
  ON fod.loan_product_key = lp.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fod.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY lp.display_name
ORDER BY lp.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fwt.customer_key) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c ON fwt.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND c.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
  AND fwt.is_cross_border = TRUE;

WITH txn_2025 AS (
  SELECT
    f.branch_key,
    d.region_code,
    COUNT(*) AS txn_count
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  GROUP BY f.branch_key, d.region_code
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_key,
    txn_count,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY txn_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM txn_2025
)
SELECT
  r.region_code,
  b.display_name AS branch_name,
  r.txn_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON r.branch_key = b.branch_key
WHERE r.rn = 1;

SELECT dm.merchant_category_code,
       SUM(fca.original_amount) AS total_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant dm
    ON fca.merchant_key = dm.merchant_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
    ON fca.business_date_key = dd.date_key
 WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dd.calendar_date) = 2025
 GROUP BY dm.merchant_category_code
 ORDER BY total_amount DESC
 LIMIT 3;

SELECT
  c.business_id,
  SUM(f.settlement_amount) AS total_wire_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c
  ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.business_id
ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT d.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
       SUM(f.settlement_amount) AS total_settlement_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ddate ON f.business_date_key = ddate.date_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency d ON f.currency_key = d.currency_key
 WHERE ddate.calendar_year_number = 2025
 GROUP BY d.iso_alpha_code
 ORDER BY total_settlement_amount DESC;

WITH wire_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.customer_key
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
), atm_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT f.customer_key
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers_both
FROM wire_customers w
JOIN atm_customers a ON w.customer_key = a.customer_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fw
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fw.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fw
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fw.business_date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key

SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dc.complaint_category_key

GROUP BY dc.display_name

SELECT

FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key

 WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT customer_segment_code AS segment,

FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount_2025

WHERE fd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'

SELECT d.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025

JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction d
  ON f.jurisdiction_key = d.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON f.business_date_key = dt.date_key

  AND dt.calendar_year_number = 2025

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS mobile_app_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key

SELECT
    dp.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(fod.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement fod
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product dp
  ON fod.loan_product_key = dp.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd
  ON fod.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY dp.display_name
ORDER BY dp.display_name;

FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c ON fwt.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND c.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
  AND fwt.is_cross_border = TRUE;

  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key

),
branch_counts AS (

    b.region_code,
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_txn_count

  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON t.branch_key = b.branch_key
  GROUP BY b.region_code, b.display_name
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    region_code,
    branch_name,
    atm_txn_count,

  FROM branch_counts
)
SELECT region_code, branch_name, atm_txn_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant m
  ON f.merchant_key = m.merchant_key
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM f.authorized_at) = 2025
GROUP BY m.merchant_category_code
ORDER BY total_authorized_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT c.business_id,
       SUM(f.settlement_amount) AS total_wire_amount

    ON f.customer_key = c.customer_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
 WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
 GROUP BY c.business_id
 ORDER BY total_wire_amount DESC
 LIMIT 5;

SELECT d.currency_code,
       SUM(f.settlement_amount) AS total_settlement_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date ddate ON f.business_date_key = ddate.date_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency d ON f.currency_key = d.currency_key
 WHERE ddate.calendar_year_number = 2025
 GROUP BY d.currency_code
 ORDER BY total_settlement_amount DESC;

WITH wire_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fwt.customer_key
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
), atm_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fta.customer_key
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction fta
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fta.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customers
FROM wire_customers wc
JOIN atm_customers ac ON wc.customer_key = ac.customer_key;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fw
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fw.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS wire_transfer_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fw
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fw.business_date_key = d.date_key
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS bank_dwh.fact_complaint;

SELECT display_name
FROM bank_dwh.dim_branch
WHERE is_current = TRUE
ORDER BY display_name;

INSERT INTO bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily (
    business_date_key,
    organization_key,
    branch_key,
    currency_key,
    product_key,
    market_key,
    mid_rate,
    ingested_at,
    updated_at
) SELECT
    d.date_key,
    NULL::BIGINT,
    NULL::BIGINT,
    NULL::BIGINT,
    NULL::BIGINT,
    NULL::BIGINT,
    1.10::NUMERIC(14,8),
    now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',
    now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
FROM bank_dwh.dim_date d
WHERE d.calendar_date = '2025-12-31';

SELECT
  c.iso_alpha_code AS currency,
  SUM(f.original_amount) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.iso_alpha_code
ORDER BY total_volume DESC;

SELECT
    ch.display_name AS channel_name,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel ch
  ON f.channel_key = ch.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY ch.display_name
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT business_id) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
  AND is_active = TRUE;

SELECT d.display_name AS jurisdiction,
       COUNT(*) AS alert_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction d
  ON f.jurisdiction_key = d.jurisdiction_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON f.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM dt.calendar_date) = 2025
GROUP BY d.display_name
ORDER BY alert_count DESC;

SELECT
    b.display_name AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY b.display_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.business_id) AS clients_in_default
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS d ON d.date_key = f.business_date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer AS c ON c.customer_key = f.customer_key
WHERE f.default_flag = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_date = (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot_day.calendar_date)
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily AS snapshot_fact
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date AS snapshot_day ON snapshot_day.date_key = snapshot_fact.business_date_key
    WHERE snapshot_day.calendar_year_number = 2025
      AND snapshot_day.month_number = 8
  );

SELECT dc.display_name AS complaint_category,
       COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fc.business_date_key = d.date_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dc.complaint_category_key
 WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
 GROUP BY dc.display_name
 ORDER BY complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
    c.iso_alpha_code AS currency_code,
    AVG(f.average_rate) AS avg_daily_rate_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_currency c ON f.currency_key = c.currency_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY c.iso_alpha_code
ORDER BY c.iso_alpha_code;

SELECT
    m.market_id,
    m.display_name AS market_name,
    SUM(f.market_value_amount) AS total_market_value
FROM bank_dwh.fact_portfolio_valuation_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_market m
  ON f.market_key = m.market_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY m.market_id, m.display_name
ORDER BY total_market_value DESC;

SELECT account_type_code,
       COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened_2025
  FROM bank_dwh.dim_account
 WHERE opened_date >= '2025-01-01'
   AND opened_date <  '2026-01-01'
 GROUP BY account_type_code
 ORDER BY account_type_code;

SELECT b.city_name AS branch_city,
       COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b
  ON f.branch_key = b.branch_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.quarter_number = 1
GROUP BY b.city_name
ORDER BY atm_transaction_count DESC;

SELECT AVG(f.closing_balance_amount) AS avg_closing_balance
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_balance_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_date = DATE '2025-06-30';

SELECT AVG(mid_rate) AS avg_mid_rate_usd_dec_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_fx_rate_daily f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE f.currency_code = 'USD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND d.month_number = 12;

SELECT d.month_number,
       COUNT(*) AS dispute_count
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
    ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
 WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
 GROUP BY d.month_number
 ORDER BY d.month_number;

SELECT
    customer_segment_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_key) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
WHERE is_current = TRUE
GROUP BY customer_segment_code
ORDER BY customer_segment_code;

WITH customers AS (
    SELECT customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.dim_customer
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
),
trans_2025 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT f.customer_key
    FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
    JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_no_tx_2025
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN trans_2025 t ON c.customer_key = t.customer_key
WHERE t.customer_key IS NULL;

SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN payment_status_code = 'DECLINED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
  , 2) AS declined_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT
    dc.display_name AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.fact_complaint fc
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON fc.business_date_key = dd.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_complaint_category dc ON fc.complaint_category_key = dc.complaint_category_key
WHERE dd.calendar_year_number = 2025
  AND fc.is_escalated = TRUE
GROUP BY dc.display_name
ORDER BY escalated_complaint_count DESC;

SELECT
  ch.display_name AS channel_name,
  SUM(fat.fee_amount) AS total_fees
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction fat
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel ch
  ON fat.channel_key = ch.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON fat.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY ch.display_name
ORDER BY total_fees DESC;

SELECT SUM(transaction_amount) AS total_fraud_dispute_amount_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_dispute fd
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fd.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE fd.dispute_reason_code = 'FRAUD'
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

SELECT d.display_name AS jurisdiction_name,
       COUNT(*) AS high_severity_alerts_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_aml_alert f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dte ON f.business_date_key = dte.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_jurisdiction d ON f.jurisdiction_key = d.jurisdiction_key
WHERE f.alert_severity_code = 'HIGH'
  AND dte.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.display_name
ORDER BY high_severity_alerts_2025 DESC;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT loan_id) AS loans_over_90_days_past_due
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_delinquency_daily d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dd ON d.business_date_key = dd.date_key
WHERE dd.calendar_date = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND d.days_past_due > 90;

SELECT d.calendar_year_number AS year,
       COUNT(*) AS mobile_app_transactions
FROM bank_dwh.fact_account_transaction f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_channel c
  ON f.channel_key = c.channel_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d
  ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE c.display_name = 'Mobile App'
  AND d.calendar_year_number IN (2024,2025)
GROUP BY d.calendar_year_number
ORDER BY d.calendar_year_number;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS loan_product_name,
    SUM(d.outstanding_principal_amount) AS total_outstanding_principal
FROM bank_dwh.fact_loan_disbursement d
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_loan_product p
  ON d.loan_product_key = p.loan_product_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt
  ON d.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY p.display_name
ORDER BY p.display_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fwt.customer_key) AS distinct_sme_crossborder_customers_2025
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer fwt
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON fwt.business_date_key = d.date_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer c ON fwt.customer_key = c.customer_key
WHERE c.customer_segment_code = 'SME'
  AND fwt.is_cross_border = TRUE
  AND d.calendar_year_number = 2025;

WITH tx_2025 AS (
  SELECT f.branch_key
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_atm_transaction f
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
  WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
),
branch_counts AS (
  SELECT b.region_code,
         b.display_name,
         COUNT(*) AS atm_tx_count
  FROM tx_2025 t
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_branch b ON t.branch_key = b.branch_key
  GROUP BY b.region_code, b.display_name
)
SELECT region_code,
       display_name,
       atm_tx_count
FROM (
  SELECT bc.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY region_code ORDER BY atm_tx_count DESC) AS rn
  FROM branch_counts bc
) sub
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT dmca.merchant_category_code,
       SUM(fca.original_amount) AS total_authorized_amount
  FROM bank_dwh.fact_card_authorization fca
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant dm ON fca.merchant_key = dm.merchant_key
  JOIN bank_dwh.dim_merchant_category dmca ON dm.merchant_category_code = dmca.merchant_category_code
 WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM fca.authorized_at) = 2025
 GROUP BY dmca.merchant_category_code
 ORDER BY total_authorized_amount DESC
 LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.business_id,
       SUM(f.original_amount) AS total_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_customer d ON f.customer_key = d.customer_key
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date dt ON f.business_date_key = dt.date_key
WHERE dt.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.business_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    d.currency_code,
    SUM(f.settlement_amount) AS total_settlement_amount
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.currency_code
ORDER BY total_settlement_amount DESC;

    now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC',

SELECT
    d.currency_code,
    SUM(f.original_amount) AS total_volume
FROM bank_dwh.fact_wire_transfer f
JOIN bank_dwh.dim_date d ON f.business_date_key = d.date_key
WHERE d.calendar_year_number = 2025
GROUP BY d.currency_code
